lore_anchors.definition: The secret technique accessed by consuming Shangguan Yuting's head; it grants a fleeting vision of the world's underlying truth by fusing multiple sensory and cognitive inputs.
A mortal who serves as a Siming's causal anchor to the world; becoming a Heart-Pan effectively rewrites the mortal's past so they become a younger version of the god.
The Siming of Destiny, who previously granted Li Huowang the identity of "Red Center"; she has been scheming to make him her Heart-Pan all along.
The pain-feeding primordial deity of the Ao-Jing Sect; Li Huowang realizes Bashe has also been angling to claim him as a Heart-Pan ever since the *Thousand Greats Record*.
A folk-religious ritual where practitioners invite deities into their bodies through self-mutilation (striking the forehead with a knife) as proof of divine possession.
A Chinese symbol of inseparable love; here it represents Bai Lingmiao's split-body manifestation, where her two halves act independently with different emotions.
A high-ranking Zuowandao member who has taken over Gao Zhijian's body; known for his taunting, truth-twisting style of psychological warfare.
A stolen cosmic eye now serving as Doumu's instrument; it reveals the true shape of divine plans to those who gaze into it.
The assistant medium in a spirit-dance ritual; under Bai Lingmiao's command, she acts as a second singer and combatant from beneath the red veil.
Elite Martial clansmen clad in armor made from dragon scales; they are nearly immune to supernatural abilities and are the emperor's foremost battlefield assets.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is a Heart-Pan in the Dao-Twisted World?
cultural_notes_faq.a: A Heart-Pan (心蟠) is a mortal chosen by a Siming to serve as its "past" or "seed" in the mortal realm. Becoming one effectively rewrites history so the mortal becomes a younger version of the god, locking in the god's continued existence.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did Li Huowang's head explode?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The Supreme Extremity Confluence forced him to process an overwhelming amount of cosmic truth at once. His body couldn't contain the strain, so his head burst—but thanks to his Heart-Element constitution and internal parasites, he survived as a talking mouth on a tentacled neck.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What did Li Huowang see in the Eye of the Mountain God?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He saw Doumu's plan: if he accepts becoming her Heart-Pan, the Doumu of the present becomes his own future self. This means the crisis could be resolved by walking a predestined path—but it also means losing his own separate identity.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Is Bai Lingmiao's twin-lotus form permanent?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It appears to be a temporary combat state triggered by the "Rise, Possessed Medium" ritual. She splits into two upper bodies, each with a different emotion (mercy and savagery), and fights alongside her Second Spirit.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does Bashe also want Li Huowang as a Heart-Pan?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Bashe and Doumu are competing Simings. Both see Li Huowang's unique Heart-Element constitution as an ideal anchor. Bashe's claim dates back to when Li Huowang first used the *Thousand Greats Record*—the Ao-Jing Sect's foundational artifact.
